description: This Java class 'VisitHandler' manages user visit tracking and visitor information within the OFBiz web application. It handles creating and updating visit and visitor entities, managing session attributes, and setting cookies for visitor identification.

classes.name: VisitHandler
classes.description: Handles saving and maintaining visit information, including creating visit and visitor entities, updating session attributes, and managing visitor cookies.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Associates a user login with the current visit and visitor, updating relevant entity fields.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Retrieves the current visit ID from the session.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the current visit entity from the session or creates a new one if missing.

methods.name: getVisitor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a visitor entity based on cookies and session data, and manages setting the visitor cookie.
